capability_matrix.notes: Mission created and follows full state machine lifecycle (RECEIVED -> ANALYZING -> PLANNING -> DESIGNING -> REVIEWING -> APPROVED -> AWAITING_APPROVAL -> EXECUTING -> EXECUTED -> VERIFYING -> EVIDENCED -> ADJUDICATED)
Run created, tracked, completed. Parent-child relationship for resume.
Atomic reservation (E15) works. Lifecycle: REGISTERED->AVAILABLE->ASSIGNED->RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED. Agent reassignment on retry works.
17 tools available. Sandbox execution verified (run_command, write_file, read_artifact).
WindowsExecutor backend used. Isolated per-task sandboxes. Timeout enforcement works.
Artifacts created with SHA256, stored in evidence store, linked to task/agent.
Evidence records created for artifacts. SHA256 verified.
Independent verification via verify_task(). Verdicts: evidenced/passed/failed. Not dependent on agent claim.
Full event log persisted to disk (JSONL). Includes mission.state_changed, checkpoint.created, human.gate.created, replan.requested/applied, etc.
Created every N tasks. Saved to disk (JSON). Contains task states, attempt history, task definitions, dependencies, artifacts, evidence.
Cross-runtime resume works. Auto-recreates Mission object. Completed tasks skipped (marked resumed: true).
Retry with exponential backoff (configurable). Agent reassignment on retry. Max retries respected. Terminal failure correctly reported.
Dynamic task graph modification during execution. Add/modify/remove tasks, change dependencies. Emits REPLAN_REQUESTED/APPLIED events. Graph versioning.
create_human_gate()/decide_human_gate() integrated. Transitions EXECUTING -> HUMAN_REQUIRED -> EXECUTING (continue) or CANCELLED (cancel). Events persisted.
